⚡ BoltBeam                                                             (˘ω˘) zz
╭──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ Fetch runs                                                                   │
│ Fetch runs from another machine (a pod, a Linux box) over SSH, as boltbeam   │
│ fetch does.                                                                  │
│                                                                              │
│ Each run lands in saved runs with its chip profile, every file checked by    │
│ sha256. Nothing on the remote changes.                                       │
│                                                                              │
│                                                                              │
│                                                                              │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
╭──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ What next                                                                    │
│ ┃ Remote                                                                     │
│ ┃ user@host, or an ssh Host alias                                            │
│ ┃ > user@host                                                                │
│                                                                              │
│   Port                                                                       │
│   the remote's SSH port; empty for ssh's own (a pod names one)               │
│   > ssh's own                                                                │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
